135:### Documentation style
136-
137-- Put the main point first, then the details (the pyramid principle).
138-- Use short sentences, the active voice, and the imperative for instructions ([ASD-STE100](https://www.asd-ste100.org/) where it applies).
139-- Write each fact in one place, and link to it from other places.
140-- Make sure that each claim agrees with the code. If possible, add a test.
141-
142-## CI workflows
143-
144-| Workflow | What it does |
145-|----------|--------------|
146-| [`ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml) | Runs `npm run check` on pushes and pull requests to `main`. On pull requests, the `commitlint` job checks the message of each commit with [`commitlint.config.js`](commitlint.config.js) |
147-| [`pi-assistant.yml`](.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml) | Uses the action of this checkout to answer `@pi` requests in this repository. It acts as the `pi-action-agent` GitHub App (secrets `PI_APP_CLIENT_ID` and `PI_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`), so that pi can open pull requests and its pushes run CI |
148-| [`pi-direct-dogfood.yml`](.github/workflows/pi-direct-dogfood.yml) | `workflow_dispatch`: runs a direct prompt in `output` mode |
149-| [`pi-pr-review-dogfood.yml`](.github/workflows/pi-pr-review-dogfood.yml) | `workflow_dispatch`: reviews a pull request with `pr_number` in `output` mode |
150-
151-## Releases
152-
153-1. Make sure that `npm run check` passes on `main`.
154-2. Change `version` in `package.json`. Commit with the message `chore: release X.Y.Z`.
155-3. Tag the commit `vX.Y.Z`.
156-4. Move the major tag (`v2`) to the same commit. Users refer to the action as `cv/pi-action@v2`.
157-
158-## Pull requests
159-
160-1. Make a branch with a descriptive name, such as `feat/123-description`.
161-2. Write tests for new behavior.
162-3. Make sure that all hooks and `npm run check` pass.
163-4. Use Conventional Commits.
164-5. Keep the change small: one feature or one fix in each pull request.
165-6. Update the documentation when you add features or change behavior.
export default {
	extends: ["@commitlint/config-conventional"],
	rules: {
		// Enforce lowercase for type
		"type-case": [2, "always", "lower-case"],
		// Allowed types
		"type-enum": [
			2,
			"always",
			[
				"feat", // New feature
				"fix", // Bug fix
				"docs", // Documentation only
				"style", // Formatting, no code change
				"refactor", // Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
				"perf", // Performance improvement
				"test", // Adding or updating tests
				"build", // Build system or dependencies
				"ci", // CI configuration
				"chore", // Other changes that don't modify src or test
				"revert", // Revert a previous commit
			],
		],
		// Subject should not be empty
		"subject-empty": [2, "never"],
		// Subject should not end with period
		"subject-full-stop": [2, "never", "."],
		// Header should be 100 chars or less
		"header-max-length": [2, "always", 100],
	},
